articles.title: Sejarah Tingkatan 3 textbook (TRANSLATED)
articles.excerpt: Form 3 History textbook translated into English and Chinese
articles.content:
History may be a very hard and unnecessary subject that our schools have forced us to shove into our brains and ruin our day.

However, with the power of technology, I have translated the miserable Form 3 History textbook and made it actually comprehensible! (if your Malay sucks)

# Here are the translated versions of the textbook below:

- English: [[click here]](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jaEXCe8_ZKrrMawAayFmp_eL1W8BYFLX/view?usp=sharing)
- Chinese: [[click here]](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1v4WAxxnwi8rOs6U8aDVUwPZ6mh-LT5HD/view?usp=sharing)

Please do note that the translations may not be accurate. I advise referring to the original textbook side-by-side with the translated version(s).

All the best for whatever you need these for!

articles.title: RBT Tingkatan 3 textbook (TRANSLATED)
articles.excerpt: Form 3 RBT textbook translated into English and Chinese
articles.content:
I find RBT (Reka Bentuk dan Teknologi for more content) a really useful subject for my future. It COULD HAVE HELPED ME A LOT MORE IF IT WERE IN ENGLISH.

Hence, I translated the textbook into English and Chinese so you and I could understand what it's saying. not to be disrespectful but to be honest malay is a very difficult language to learn and understand
